helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers & designers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for Senior Designers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.

  • Direct hire: some clients hire designers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills

  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.

  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.

  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers

  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds

  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

Who we’re looking for

Senior UI & UX Designers:

  • 5+ years of experience in UI & UX Design

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Figma & 5+ years with Prototyping, OR 5+ years of commercial experience with Figma & 3+ years with Prototyping

  • Experience with Adobe is required

  • Experience in Product design is a must

Senior Graphic Designers:

  • 5+ years of experience in Graphic Design

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Adobe Creative Suite & Adobe Illustrator

  • Strong design craft — as a Senior Designer, you're expected to build polished, production-ready work from scratch, with a solid grasp of design systems, component architecture, and how your decisions translate into real product or brand outcomes.

  • Clear and confident communication in English — advanced ability to discuss creative briefs, defend design decisions, and flag blockers early. Strong self-presentation is essential, particularly on client calls.

  • High ownership, zero hand-holding — you thrive working full-time remotely, manage your own time, and consistently hit deadlines without being chased.

  • Reliability — we need to trust you completely. If you commit to something, you deliver it. If something changes, you communicate early.

  • Fast ramp-up — you can absorb project context quickly, align with existing style guides or brand directions, and start producing valuable work within the first days, not weeks.

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile

  2. Verify your role

  3. Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

Ready? Apply and join the community.

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

We're placing Senior Developers (4+ yrs commercial experience) across AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Enterprise Software Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, iOS & Swift, Flutter & Firebase, Solutions Engineer, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & An gular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, Product Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Node & TypeScript, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, Animation, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering and more. Reach out and we'll match you.

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

NeoWork is hiring Graphic Designers to create on-brand visual content for U.S. companies. You will design social posts, ads, marketing materials, and brand assets that look great and perform.

NeoWork is a global staffing and operations partner that builds dedicated remote teams for fast-growing U.S. companies. Our teammates work directly inside our clients' teams and tools, while NeoWork takes care of recruiting, HR, benefits, and ongoing support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design social media graphics, paid ads, email assets, and marketing materials
    • Create presentations, one-pagers, and brand collateral
    • Follow brand guidelines while bringing fresh creative ideas
    • Adapt designs for multiple formats and platforms
    • Collaborate with marketers, copywriters, and video editors on campaigns
    • Manage design files and deliver on tight, recurring deadlines

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional graphic design experience
    • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and/or Figma
    • A strong portfolio showcasing recent work
    • Solid understanding of typography, layout, and color
    • Good written and spoken English for working with U.S. teams
    • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
    • Based in Argentina, with a reliable home office setup and stable internet connection

Nice to Have

  • Experience with motion graphics or video
    • Experience designing for e-commerce or performance marketing

Benefits

  • We offer health insurance for contractors

• Holiday Extra Pay

  • The work hours generally align with standard business hours in the US, with some potential flexibility depending on the client's needs.
    • This is a 100% home-based position
    • We prioritize the mental health of our team members and offer mental health days to support their well-being.
    • In addition to the base salary, performance-based incentives are provided.
    • There is an annual review and appraisal process in place.
    • There are ample opportunities for professional growth and advancement within the company.

RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

About Evo

For over 20 years, The Evolution Championship Series (Evo), has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are rallying points where fans, publishers, developers, and brands celebrate fighting games and the communities that love them. Beyond our established live events, Evo’s mission continues to evolve to create, celebrate, and renew fighting game fandom.

Role Overview

Evo is looking for a talented, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our creative team. This is a mid-level role for a designer who can translate creative direction into polished, effective visual assets across event collateral, social media assets, broadcast graphics, and marketing collateral.

The ideal candidate has a clean, modern design aesthetic, solid fundamentals in typography and visual communication, and the ability to move confidently between fast-turnaround digital work and print production. You should be comfortable working within established brand systems while also bringing thoughtful creative ideas to the table.

Reporting Structure

You will report to Evo’s Creative Director.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support Evo's creative output by designing assets for a variety of Evo events, initiatives, and projects.
  • Create social media graphics and other digital marketing assets.
  • Design digital maps, schedules, wayfinding materials, and event information graphics.
  • Create web assets across Evo's digital platforms.
  • Develop broadcast graphics for Evo tournaments and events.
  • Design event signage, environmental graphics, and other on-site materials for Evo events.
  • Create YouTube thumbnails for both the Evo FGC and Evo Events channels.
  • Design presentations and decks for internal use, client presentations, and partner-facing materials.
  • Prepare, package, and distribute production-ready files for print vendors and other external partners.
  • Collaborate with creative, sales, comms and marketing teams to execute projects from concept through final delivery.
  • Maintain consistency with Evo's brand standards as well as the visual guidelines of relevant partners and clients.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience in graphic design or other relevant fields.
  • Strong proficiency in:
    • Adobe Photoshop
    • Adobe Illustrator
    • Figma
    • Google Sheets, Docs, Drive, and Slides
  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, and fundamental graphic design principles.
  • Competency in print production, including preparing files for professional printing and understanding production requirements.
  • Strong design portfolio demonstrating a clean, modern, and thoughtful design aesthetic.
  • Proven ability to package, organize, and distribute files accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow, apply, and maintain brand standards and guidelines across Evo, partner, and client work.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high standard for craft and execution.
  • Ability to receive creative direction, incorporate feedback, and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, event-driven environment.
Bonus Points
  • Passion for fighting games, esports, gaming and gaming communities.
  • Experience creating motion graphics or animation.
  • Experience with 3D design, rendering, or visualization.
  • Experience with web design and digital product design.
  • Experience with photo editing, compositing, and retouching.
  • Previous experience designing for live events, entertainment, sports, or other high-energy audience-driven environments.
Compensation

The salary for this role is $55,000.00 to $80,000.00 depending on experience.

Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  • 401k plan available for employee contributions
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
  • Remote-first culture

We’re looking for a freelance, multi-disciplinary Creative Designer to join our team and support us with a variety of creative projects across graphic design, landing pages, Figma, video editing, and animation.

We need someone who can work across different types of content rather than specializing in just one area.

What You’ll Work On

  • Design website and landing pages in Figma

  • Create social media graphics and marketing creatives

  • Design creatives for organic and paid ads

  • Create visuals for web, apps, and digital campaigns

  • Edit short-form videos for social media and marketing

  • Create simple animations and motion graphics

  • Turn creative briefs and ideas into polished visual content

  • Adapt designs into different formats and platforms

  • Work closely with our team on ongoing creative requests

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in graphic design, video editing, and animation

  • Strong Figma skills

  • Experience designing landing pages / web interfaces

  • Strong portfolio showcasing social media, digital, and marketing creatives

  • Comfortable with video editing and creating simple animations

  • Strong eye for design, typography, composition, and visual storytelling

  • Able to work independently and turn around projects quickly

  • Good communication and responsiveness

Tools

Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar tools.

Ideal Candidate

We’re particularly interested in someone who can do both design and video. The ability to move from a landing page or social media graphic to a video or simple animation without needing to outsource another part of the work is a major plus.

This is a freelance opportunity with potential for ongoing work.

To Apply

Please send:

  1. Your portfolio

  2. Examples of your landing page/Figma work

  3. Examples of social media creatives

  4. Examples of video editing and animation

  5. Your hourly rate and availability

We’re looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.
